lines.en: label conveniencegen:
scene conveniencegen
I decide to head over to the convenience store to spend some time with Noriko.
lines.zh: 我决定去便利店，和 Noriko 待一会儿。

lines.en: The strange thing is that I don't particularly remember when I decided this or how I even got here.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是，我并不太记得自己是什么时候做的这个决定，也不知道自己是怎么到的这里。

lines.en: But I'm here nonetheless, so I might as well have a good time talking about some of the weird stuff Noriko is into.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样我都已经在这儿了，所以不妨开开心心地聊聊 Noriko 热衷的那些怪东西。

lines.en: Or at least that's what I expect to do, but the conversation winds up being surprisingly natural and {i}mostly{/i} normal.
lines.zh: 至少我原本是这么打算的，但聊着聊着，对话意外地变得自然，而且{i}大体上{/i}还很正常。

lines.en: We walk around the store reading the ingredients on the back of bottles and Noriko explains to me what each and every one of the ingredients does to the human body.
lines.zh: 我们在店里转悠，读着瓶子背面的配料表，Noriko 给我解释每一种配料会对人体产生什么作用。

lines.en: Now, I'm sure you're probably thinking that this isn't normal at all.
lines.zh: 这会儿，我猜你大概在想，这一点也不正常。

lines.en: But for Noriko, I think it's actually pretty good.
lines.zh: 但对 Noriko 来说，我觉得这其实挺好的。

lines.en: A step in the right direction, if you will.
lines.zh: 可以说是朝正确的方向迈出了一步。

lines.en: scene black
But I guess when every step is so misplaced, even crooked paths are better than nothing.
lines.zh: 不过我想，当每一步都踩得那么错位时，即便是歪歪扭扭的路，也总比没有强。

lines.en: I wind up staying at the store much later than I ever intended to.
lines.zh: 结果我在店里待的时间，比我原本打算的晚太多了。

lines.en: I think it's around midnight by the time I finally leave.
lines.zh: 我最后离开的时候，我想大概已经是午夜了。

lines.en: Instead of leaving alone, though, I head back with Noriko.
lines.zh: 不过我不是一个人走的，而是和 Noriko 一起回去。

lines.en: She winds up calling over a ride for us and, before I know it, we're in the backseat of an unfamiliar car sitting shoulder to shoulder.
lines.zh: 她叫了辆车，不知不觉间，我们就肩并肩坐在一辆陌生汽车的后座上。

lines.en: She stares at me the entire time.
lines.zh: 她一路上都在盯着我看。

lines.en: I stare back at her every minute or so.
lines.zh: 我大概每隔一分钟就回看她一眼。

lines.en: And then I arrive home.
